VCTCN: VALORANT Champions Tour China, the Chinese Valorant league; at the 2026 Champions in Shanghai all four Chinese teams went out in the first round (0-8 in Bo3s), so fans use it as shorthand for a home-crowd flop
CBLOL: Brazil's League of Legends league, often mocked as a weak region
一轮游: going out in the very first round of a tournament
S赛: the League of Legends World Championship (Worlds)
德杯: the Demacia Cup, a Chinese LoL off-season tournament
德玛西亚杯: the Demacia Cup, a Chinese LoL off-season tournament
外卡: the "wildcard" minor regions (outside China, Korea, Europe and North America), often used dismissively
LCP: League Championship Pacific, the Pacific league (Japan, Vietnam, Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macau, Oceania, Southeast Asia)
LTA: League of the Americas, the combined North and South American league
豆包: Doubao, ByteDance's AI chatbot app; fans joke that a coach or player should just ask it for help
pigwei: a mocking nickname for AL head coach BigWei (Big turned into Pig)
德云色: DYS (De Yun Se), a popular Chinese LoL streaming group that co-streams pro matches
卡列: Kalista + Renata Glasc, a bot-lane duo
管泽元: Guan Zeyuan, a well-known Chinese LoL caster
国补: "national subsidy": easy wins handed to LPL teams in the Swiss 0-1 pool
同意: Hupu joke: "agreeing" to a surrender vote, i.e. giving up in a hard game
卖票: "selling tickets": losing a match that would have qualified you, so the spot goes to the other team
卖票小子: "ticket-selling kid": a player who keeps losing the matches that decide international spots
